lineage.strategy: Use issuer-filed 6-K operating review for current segment economics and scaling evidence.

observations.fact: Nebius reported Q2 2026 total revenue of $582.3M versus $105.1M a year earlier; AI-cloud revenue was $574.9M, up 514%, with growth attributed to capacity scaling, pricing and utilization. Cost of revenue was 23% of revenue versus 29% a year earlier.

risks.risk: Q2 operating loss remained $175.9M and depreciation/amortization reached $259.7M as GPU and data-center investment scaled; rapid growth remains capital intensive.

unknowns.unknown: Durability of current utilization/pricing and return on accelerated infrastructure investment remain unproven over a full cycle.

recommendation: Use as current source-addressed growth, unit-cost and capital-intensity evidence; Alpha retains numeric underwriting.
